title.en: An Act to Amend Item Twenty-One of the Public Works Projects for the Province of Quezon, Sub-Section (a), Title A, Section One of Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred Seventy
title.orig: An Act to Amend Item Twenty-One of the Public Works Projects for the Province of Quezon, Sub-Section (a), Title A, Section One of Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred Seventy

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1208_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item twenty-one of the public works projects for the Province of Quezon, subsection (a), title A, section one of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred seventy, is amended to read as follows:
"21. For the construction of the Sto. Cristo School Building, Sariaya ₱5,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 20, 1955.
